name: Jump Rope [TROLL SQUID GAME]
desc:
🪢 JUMP ROPE UPDATE – The newest Squid Game: Season 3 challenge is here – Jump Rope – now playable on Roblox!

💀 Time your jumps, avoid the swinging rope, and watch out for other players trying to slap you off the edge with crazy gloves!

🧤 The more wins you get, the more powerful slap gloves you unlock – each with unique effects to help you survive (or ruin someone else's run).

🚨 More games from Squid Game Season 3 may be added soon – stay tuned for updates!

👍 Don’t forget to like and favorite if you’re hyped for more Squid Game content!
